reason: Move captured hunk text out of the mutable workspace_change row so state transitions do not reconstruct large SQLite records and overflow pages. Copy every nonempty text pair into workspace_change_text, preserve row ids and FK witnesses, seed the durable retired-text index, then drop both hot-row text columns.
